title: Dot Plot (Line Plot)
description: Dots stacked above a number line, one dot per data value. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (one-variable-data): mean/median/mode comparisons, spread, and effect of removing a value — all computable from the same entries the figure shows.

entries.description: Distinct values on the number line with their dot counts; the full dataset is entries expanded by count.

count.description: Dots stacked at this value; capped so columns never exceed the figure height.

tickStep.description: Number-line tick spacing; null lets the renderer pick the coarsest step that still lands on every entry value.

markMean.description: Draw a triangle marker at the dataset mean (computed from entries, never authored).

markMedian.description: Draw a vertical tick at the dataset median (computed from entries, never authored).

notes: Renderer guarantees: entries are sorted by value before drawing; duplicate values are a parse-time error; axis extent is padded one tick beyond min/max entry so no dot sits on an axis end; mean/median markers (if requested) are computed from the expanded dataset, so statistics questions derive from the identical data.
